title: Fear shapes your attention
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What is the fear that decides where you look?

Jose said: let's say we have a childhood trauma. We were criticized as a child, and now we are very self-conscious. I may get criticized here, so I don't want to take this risk, because I'll be ridiculed. That negative belief system becomes our inability to take action.

Our fear can sometimes shape where we put our attention, he said. Imagine you have billions invested in a company and its value has fallen and one message is decimating its sales. Fear can shape what you pay attention to, and you can make decisions from a place of fear.
The way you perceive things becomes your reality, he said, and that reality becomes your belief system, and the belief system reinforces the survival pattern.

We have to be careful in moments of crisis, Jose said. We need a structure to deal with it, a makeup of who we are, because the amount of risk we take is huge. You can't make decisions from fear. You can't make decisions when you are in a negative survival pattern, or when you are stuck in a childhood traumatizing event.
A student said: the presence effect, too. People will not approach someone to bring up sensitive subjects when family is there.
A student said: the difference between paying attention and concentration. Jose said: yes, a deep ability to concentrate, to switch everything else off.

Jose said: the point is being aware of our survival patterns and our limitations, and how they become habits. Saying to yourself: this is a totally irrational habit I have that could be self-destructive, and I don't need it. I can drop that and create something positive.
What would you do with your attention if you were not afraid?
Education, not advice. If this is heavy for you, a trained person can help.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what you were criticized for as a child, if you want to.
Write the risk it stops you taking.
Write where fear puts your attention in a crisis.
Write what you will do before you decide when you are afraid.
Write the irrational habit you could drop.

check.q: What did Jose say fear can shape?
What did Jose say you can't do from fear?
What did a student say is the difference between concentration and what?

recap: Notice where fear puts your attention. Don't decide from fear. Drop an irrational habit.
